scope: three grids at amplitude 1e-4 through at most 6T; no other amplitude or extension is authorized
source_interpretation: Problem.Amplitude is an additive salt-mole-fraction coefficient multiplying A28(y)*cos(2*pi*x/lambda); it does not alter wavelength or profile.

comparison_axes.amplitude_sensitivity: 1e-6 versus 1e-4 on the same grid only

registered_metrics.nonlinear_milestone: first accepted step of 50 consecutive accepted steps with H23 >= 1e-5
registered_metrics.sustained_positive_advective_flux: first accepted step of 50 consecutive accepted steps with conservative SCVF net advective salt flux > 1e-15 m/s
registered_metrics.local_downward_velocity: first two consecutive saved fields with max downward water velocity > 1e-10 m/s and downward-area fraction > 0.001
registered_metrics.odd_mode_fraction: sum odd nonzero horizontal Fourier energy / sum all nonzero horizontal Fourier energy
registered_metrics.milestone_alignment: plot against t-t_nl only when the registered milestone is observed; never optimize shifts

claim_boundary: accelerated nonlinear convergence benchmark; not a replacement for A=1e-6 and not validation of solubility-crossing time
